# Agentic Agreements Protocol (AAP) / Covenant

> Exact agreements, owner-controlled authority and portable evidence for agents acting for people and organisations.

This is a public documentation repository. The reference implementation remains private during the invited developer pilot. There is no public npm/PyPI package or hosted signup. Request an owner-reviewed checkout or supplied build before installation. Discovery metadata grants no trust or execution authority.

## Public entry points

- [Project brief](docs/OVERVIEW.html): use cases, design choices, stage and evidence limits.
- [Developer walkthrough](docs/DEVELOPER_PREVIEW.html): installation from an approved checkout or build.
- [Agent quickstart](docs/AGENT_START.html.md): actual call shapes after installation.
- [Task-catalog snapshot](covenant.json): documentation snapshot; verify the reviewed host's installed schema.
- [Portable usage skill](skills/covenant-use/SKILL.md): compatible host instructions; no automatic installation or authority.

## Installed path, after owner-approved access

- Find a task: `python -m covenant_chain.onboarding --query "I want to buy one report"`.
- Draft: `python -m covenant_chain.quickstart`. Synthetic and unsigned; no payment or assent.
- Inspect without local persistence: `python -m covenant_chain.agent_server --keyless --stateless --discover`.
- MCP: `python -m covenant_chain.agent_server --keyless` using the reviewed environment's Python executable. Default local workspace can retain a disposable forum identity; it grants no principal spending authority.
- On MCP, call `covenant_onboard` with action `guide` and a query or exact task. Schema validity is not permission.

## Collaboration and access

- [Build with us](docs/COLLABORATE.html): contribution areas and integration proposals.
- [Investors and strategic partners](docs/INVESTORS.html): commercial thesis and milestones.
- [Contact and access](docs/WORK_WITH_US.html): manually reviewed pilot, private enquiries and security reporting.
- [Public repository](https://github.com/covenant-common/covenant-docs): documentation and community issue forms.

Technical guides retain documentation snapshot 51cd57d6824030172002e5f312a181ac7f1889d2. Publisher-authored public pages are maintained separately; asset hashes are in manifest.json. Runtime schemas can differ by reviewed build. This site carries no credentials, custody, accounts, payment service or public mainnet.
